import json
from qb.next_palindrome import next_palindrome

CASES = [[[[1, 4, 9, 4, 1]], [1, 5, 0, 5, 1]], [[[1, 3, 1]], [1, 4, 1]], [[[4, 7, 2, 5, 5, 2, 7, 4]], [4, 7, 2, 6, 6, 2, 7, 4]], [[[4, 7, 2, 5, 2, 7, 4]], [4, 7, 2, 6, 2, 7, 4]], [[[9, 9, 9]], [1, 0, 0, 1]]]


def check():
    for input_data, expected in CASES:
        got = next_palindrome(*input_data)
        assert json.loads(json.dumps(got, default=list)) == expected, "next_palindrome(%r) returned %r, expected %r" % (input_data, got, expected)
